/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectYngbsInfo - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT T1.CNSTN_YN AS CNSTN_YN ,T1.CNSTN_YR AS CNSTN_YR ,T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO ,T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO ,T1.ATFINO AS ATFINO FROM AKA300 T1 --생활기록부 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectPicPhoto - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT T1.CNSTN_YN AS CNSTN_YN ,T1.CNSTN_YR AS CNSTN_YR ,T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO ,T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO ,T2.BGNG_YMD AS BGNG_YMD ,T2.END_YMD AS END_YMD ,DECODE(T2.BGNG_YMD,NULL,'',SUBSTR(T2.BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.BGNG_YMD,7,2) || '~' || SUBSTR(T2.END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(T2.END_YMD,7,2)) AS PRD ,(SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(X.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 X /* 종사자 */ WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO) AS ENFSN_NM ,T4.INST_NM AS INST_NM ,T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN --색인일련번호 FROM AKA300 T1 --생황기록부 ,AKA390 T2 --생황기록부 담당자 ,SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ ,SAA000 T4 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO(+) AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO(+) AND T3.PIC_INST_NO = T4.INST_NO(+) AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND 'Y' = T3.PCHPRS_YN(+) AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectYngbsMatter - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.PST_ADDR ELSE T1.PST_ADDR END || ' ' || CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.DADDR ELSE T1.DADDR END AS ADDR /* 주소 */ , DECODE(CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.SXDC_SE_CD ELSE T1.SXDC_SE_CD END,'M','남성','여성') AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 대상자성별구분코드 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL THEN T2.TRPR_NM_ENCPT ELSE T1.FLNM_ENCPT END) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /* 대상자명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.RRNO_ENCPT) AS RRNO_ENCPT /* 주민등록번호 */ FROM SCA300 T1 --개인정보 , SEA200 T2 --대상자정보 , SEB100 T3 --사례기본 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO(+) = T2.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AND T2.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectAtncSittn - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT ATEND_YR AS ATEND_YR --출석연도 , SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,7,2) || '~' || SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,7,2) || '(' || REG_DAYCNT || '일' || ')' AS PRD , ATEND_DAYCNT AS ATEND_DAYCNT --출석일수 , DISS_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS DISS_ABSNC_DAYCNT --질병결석일수 , INRECO_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS INRECO_ABSNC_DAYCNT --미인정결석일수 , ETC_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS ETC_ABSNC_DAYCNT --기타결석일수 , DISS_LATEN_NOCS AS DISS_LATEN_NOCS --질병지각건수 , INRECO_LATEN_NOCS AS INRECO_LATEN_NOCS --미인정지각건수 , ETC_LATEN_NOCS AS ETC_LATEN_NOCS --기타지각건수 , DISS_LRLY_NOCS AS DISS_LRLY_NOCS --질병조퇴건수 , INRECO_LRLY_NOCS AS INRECO_LRLY_NOCS --미인정조퇴건수 , ETC_LRLY_NOCS AS ETC_LRLY_NOCS --기타조퇴건수 , DISS_RESULT_NOCS AS DISS_RESULT_NOCS --질병결과건수 , INRECO_RESULT_NOCS AS INRECO_RESULT_NOCS --미인정결과건수 , ETC_RESULT_NOCS AS ETC_RESULT_NOCS --기타결과건수 , PRTCLR_MATTER_CN AS PRTCLR_MATTER_CN --특이사항내용 , ATFINO AS ATFINO --첨부파일번호 , CASE_MNG_NO AS INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO , CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO , INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , ATEND_BGNG_YMD AS ATEND_BGNG_YMD --출석시작일자 , ATEND_END_YMD AS ATEND_END_YMD --출석종료일자 , REG_DAYCNT AS REG_DAYCNT , CASE WHEN ATFINO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRUF_PAPERS /* 증빙서류 */ FROM AKA370 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectArprCareer - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT ARPR_YR AS ARPR_YR --수상년도 , ARPR_NM AS ARPR_NM --수상명 , ARPR_GRAD_NM AS ARPR_GRAD_NM --수상등급명 , SUBSTR(ARPR_YMD,0,4) || '.' || SUBSTR(ARPR_YMD,5,2) || '.' || SUBSTR(ARPR_YMD,7,2) AS ARPR_YMD --수상일자 , CNFER_INST_NM AS CNFER_INST_NM --수여기관명 , PTCPT_TRGT_NMPR_CN AS PTCPT_TRGT_NMPR_CN --참가대상인원내용 , ATFINO AS ATFINO --첨부파일번호 , CASE_MNG_NO AS INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO , CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO , INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , CASE WHEN ATFINO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRUF_PAPERS /* 증빙서류 */ FROM AKA340 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectCertiList - 응용3팀 이승연 */
SELECT '자격증' AS SPRTN /* 구분 */ , T2.CERTI_NM AS DESIGNATION_KND /* 명칭 또는 종류 */ , T2.CERTI_CN AS NO_CN /* 번호 또는 내용 */ , T2.QLFC_ACQS_YMD AS ACQS_DATE /* 취득연월일 */ , T2.ISSU_INST_NM AS ISSU_INST /* 발급기관 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ , AKA350 T2 /* 자격증현황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectCreativeList - 응용3팀 이승연 */
SELECT T2.ACTVT_YR AS YR /* 연도 */ , T2.EXPRN_ACTVT_KND_SE_CD AS RELM /* 체험활동종류구분코드 */ , T2.ACTVT_HR AS HR /* 활동시간 */ , T2.PRTCLR_MATTER_CN AS SPCABL_MATTER /* 특이사항내용 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ , AKA360 T2 /* 창의적 체험활동상황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectSchulwList - 응용3팀 이승연 */
SELECT T2.SCHULW_YR AS YR /* 학업연도 */ , T2.SCHULW_SBJT_NM AS SUBJECT /* 학업과목명 */ , T2.SCHULW_CN AS DETAIL_ABLTYSPCABL_MATTER /* 학업내용 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ , AKA320 T2 /* 학업노력 현황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectRead - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT T2.READ_YR AS YR /* 독서연도 */ , T2.READ_SBJT_NM AS SUBJECT_RELM /* 독서과목명 */ , T2.READ_CN AS READ_ACTVT_SITTN /* 독서내용 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , CASE WHEN T2.ATFINO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRUF_PAPERS /* 증빙서류 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ ,AKA310 T2 /* 독서활동 현황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectSvcb - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT T2.SVCB_YR AS YR /* 봉사연도 */ , T2.SVCB_BGNG_YMD || '~' || T2.SVCB_END_YMD AS YMD_PRD /* 봉사시작종료일자 */ , T2.SVCB_PLACE_NM AS PLACE_SPRVSN_INST_NM /* 봉사장소명 */ , T2.ACTVT_CN AS ACTVT_CN /* 활동내용 */ , T2.SVCB_HR AS HR /* 봉사시간 */ , SUM(T2.SVCB_HR) OVER(PARTITION BY T2.CASE_MNG_NO,T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO) AS TOTAL_HR /* 누계시간 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , CASE WHEN T2.ATFINO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRUF_PAPERS /* 증빙서류 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ ,AKA330 T2 /* 봉사활동 현황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectOpnn - 응용2팀 강화영 */
SELECT T2.GNRLZ_OPNN_YR AS YR /* 종합의견연도 */ , T2.GNRLZ_OPNN_CN AS GHVR_CHAR_OPNN /* 종합의견내용 */ , T2.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ , CASE WHEN T2.ATFINO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRUF_PAPERS /* 증빙서류 */ , T2.USE_YN AS USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , T2.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ FROM AKA300 T1 /* 생활기록부 */ ,AKA380 T2 /* 종합의견 현황 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectArprCareerUpdate - 응용2팀 이태호 */
SELECT CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO , CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO , INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , ARPR_YR AS ARPR_YR , ARPR_NM AS ARPR_NM , ARPR_GRAD_NM AS ARPR_GRAD_NM , ARPR_YMD AS ARPR_YMD , CNFER_INST_NM AS CNFER_INST_NM , PTCPT_TRGT_NMPR_CN AS PTCPT_TRGT_NMPR_CN , ATFINO AS ATFINO , INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AKA340 /* 수상경력 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectAtncSittnUpdate - 응용2팀 이태호 */
SELECT ATEND_YR AS ATEND_YR --출석연도 , SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_BGNG_YMD,7,2) AS ATEND_BGNG_YMD , SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(ATEND_END_YMD,7,2) AS ATEND_END_YMD , ATEND_DAYCNT AS ATEND_DAYCNT --출석일수 , DISS_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS DISS_ABSNC_DAYCNT --질병결석일수 , INRECO_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS INRECO_ABSNC_DAYCNT --미인정결석일수 , ETC_ABSNC_DAYCNT AS ETC_ABSNC_DAYCNT --기타결석일수 , DISS_LATEN_NOCS AS DISS_LATEN_NOCS --질병지각건수 , INRECO_LATEN_NOCS AS INRECO_LATEN_NOCS --미인정지각건수 , ETC_LATEN_NOCS AS ETC_LATEN_NOCS --기타지각건수 , DISS_LRLY_NOCS AS DISS_LRLY_NOCS --질병조퇴건수 , INRECO_LRLY_NOCS AS INRECO_LRLY_NOCS --미인정조퇴건수 , ETC_LRLY_NOCS AS ETC_LRLY_NOCS --기타조퇴건수 , DISS_RESULT_NOCS AS DISS_RESULT_NOCS --질병결과건수 , INRECO_RESULT_NOCS AS INRECO_RESULT_NOCS --미인정결과건수 , ETC_RESULT_NOCS AS ETC_RESULT_NOCS --기타결과건수 , PRTCLR_MATTER_CN AS PRTCLR_MATTER_CN --특이사항내용 , NVL2(ATFINO,'Y','N') AS ATFINO --첨부파일번호 , SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO --서비스실행사업번호 FROM AKA370 /* 출석현황 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CASE_MNG_NO = #{INDV_DSCSN_REQSTD_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectPicPhotoNmNow - 응용2팀 이태호 */
SELECT Y.REAL_FILE_NM AS REAL_FILE_NM_NEW FROM SAB820 X /* 첨부파일 */ , SAB821 Y /* 첨부파일상세 */ WHERE X.ATFINO = Y.ATFINO AND X.ATFINO = Y.ATFINO AND Y.FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'N' AND X.ATFINO = #{ATFINO, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectPicPhotoNmBf - 응용2팀 이태호 */
SELECT Y.REAL_FILE_NM AS REAL_FILE_NM_BF FROM SAB820 X /* 첨부파일 */ , SAB821 Y /* 첨부파일상세 */ WHERE X.ATFINO = Y.ATFINO AND X.ATFINO = Y.ATFINO AND Y.FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'D' AND X.ATFINO = #{ATFINO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND Y.MNG_SN = (SELECT MAX(Z.MNG_SN) FROM SAB821 Z WHERE Z.ATFINO = Y.ATFINO AND Z.FILE_STTS_SE_CD != 'N' )

SELECT /* isry.drmgs.stdnt.mapper.YouthLifeRecodeDetailMapper.selectSprtSrvcList(지원서비스 검색 조회) */ T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호(TR) , T1.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T1.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , T2.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , T4.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS RESRCE_NM -- 자원명 , (SELECT SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM FROM SDA420 X WHERE X.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO) AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM -- 서비스실행사업명 , T4.SRVC_TYPE_SE_CD AS SRVC_TYPE_SE_CD -- 서비스유형구분코드 , T4.RSFR_INST_NO AS RSFR_INST_NO -- 자원제공주체번호 , NVL((SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T4.RSFR_INST_NO), (SELECT INST_NM FROM SDA600 WHERE INST_NO = T4.RSFR_INST_NO)) AS RSFR_INST_NM -- 자원제공주체명 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_PLAN_NO -- 서비스제공계획번호 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO -- 서비스제공의뢰번호 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_MTHD_SE_CD AS SRVC_PVSN_MTHD_SE_CD -- 서비스제공방법구분코드 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_CN AS SRVC_PVSN_CN -- 서비스제공내용 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD -- 서비스제공시작일자 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD AS SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD -- 서비스제공종료일자 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR -- 서비스제공시작시간 , T3.SRVC_PVSN_END_HR AS SRVC_PVSN_END_HR -- 서비스제공종료시간 , T3.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO -- 담당자번호 ,(SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.PIC_NO) AS PIC_NM -- 담당자명 , T3.TKCG_INST_NO AS
